name: What is the typical timeline for a custom kitchen remodel in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a custom kitchen remodel in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom kitchen remodel in Los Angeles varies based on complexity and scope. Generally, a complete custom kitchen renovation can take anywhere from 8 to 16 weeks from design approval to project completion. This includes phases like design finalization, material procurement, demolition, rough-ins for plumbing and electrical, installation of cabinets and countertops, and finishing touches. Factors such as custom cabinetry orders or extensive structural changes can extend this duration. We provide a detailed project schedule after the design phase is complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: A custom kitchen remodel in Los Angeles typically takes 8 to 16 weeks, depending on the project's scope and complexity. This includes design, material procurement, demolition, and installation phases.
